article.title: Appeal against order under section 54L.
article.content:
54MAppeal against order under section 54L.

Section 54M  ·  Part II · Chapter III-A  ·  page 75 of the Act
Any appeal against an order approving the resolution plan under sub-section (1) of section 54L, shall be on the grounds laid down in sub-section (3) of section 61.
